name: Boltox
bio: Boltox won three titles with Epic Avalanche in 2025 — Finnish Pro League Spring, Summer, and the Finnhouse Cup — earning a Finnish circuit triple crown. The only Estonian player in the NLC, he brings international LAN experience from GG VASARA 2025 and four years of regional competition.
subtitle: Rising Estonian talent climbing through the Nordic circuit.
highlights: Finnish Pro League 2025 triple crown with Epic Avalanche
GG VASARA 2025 LAN winner in Lithuania
Only Estonian player in the NLC
